test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which among the following comes under the theme of 'Aspirational India' according to Budget 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Education Skills**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Under the theme of '**Aspirational India,' Education and Skills, Health, and Better employment are focussed on**.
 
• The 3 components of Aspirational India were:
 
 
• **Agriculture, Irrigation, and Rural Development**
 
• **Wellness, Water, and Sanitation**
 
• **Education and Skills**
 
 
 
• Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced a** ₹ 99,300 crore allocation for education under the Aspirational India Initiative**.
 
• A sum of rupees **3000 Crore is allocated for skill development**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There were total 3 themes mentioned in the union budget 2020 presented by then Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman
 
 
• Aspirational India - In which all sections of society seek a better standard of living with access to health, education, and a better job.
 
• Economic Development For All - Under the initiative name, Sabka Sath Sabka Vikas Sabka Vishwas private sectors will help in growing our economy along with the public sector to increase its efficiency.
 
• Caring Society- To make our society humane and compassionate.
 
 
 
• The 2020 Union Budget of India was presented by the **Finance Minister, Nirmala Sitharaman on 1 February 2020, as her second budget**.
